Change c0406. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. IV; 1831 Ch. XXI.

Context before (unchanged): Who could be interested in the fate of a murderer, but the hangman who would gain his fee?

1818 text: These were my first reflections; but I soon learned that Mr. Kirwin had shewn me extreme kindness.

1831 text: These were my first reflections; but I soon learned that Mr. Kirwin had shown me extreme kindness.

Diff: These were my first reflections; but I soon learned that Mr. Kirwin had [-shewn-] {+shown+} me extreme kindness.

Context after (unchanged): He had caused the best room in the prison to be prepared for me (wretched indeed was the best); and it was he who had provided a physician and a nurse.

result.rationale: Only the orthography of the past participle changes from 'shewn' to 'shown'; the wording and meaning of Kirwin's kindness are untouched.
